name: humanize
description: Audits a draft layer by layer (vocabulary, punctuation, sentence shape, openers, closers, grammar, narrative, per-model habits) against 13 studies, then rewrites what it flags in the author's voice.

interface.shortDescription: Audit prose for AI tells at every layer, then rewrite it in the author's voice.
interface.longDescription: Reads a draft against what 13 studies measured about AI writing: word choice, punctuation, sentence shape, openers, closers, grammar, register, fiction habits, per-model quirks. A dependency-free scanner supplies the counts a model cannot eyeball, and each flag cites the sentence that triggered it.
defaultPrompt: Audit this text for AI tells, don't rewrite it.
